neighbours.label: what a food or product is actually made of or made from (its ingredients or source)
fire: The pesto is made of basil, pine nuts and garlic.
Most cheap ketchup is mostly made from corn syrup.
Traditional mochi is made of pounded glutinous rice.
This so-called crab meat is actually made from white fish.
The stew is made of lentils, carrots and onions.
The candle is made from beeswax and cotton wick.
Hummus is made of chickpeas, tahini and lemon juice.
That cheap honey is often made from sugar syrup.
quiet: The pesto tasted wonderful on fresh pasta.
Most cheap ketchup is sold in plastic bottles.
Traditional mochi is eaten at the new year.
This so-called crab meat is popular in sushi rolls.
The stew simmered on the stove for two hours.
The candle burned for most of the evening.
Hummus is served with warm pita bread.
That cheap honey sells well at the market.
